I replied to Tobias in his DM to confirm that his standing Tansleigh Packaging call for the Gannet rollout is now Tuesdays at 12:15.

I didn't save it to gbrain separately. The workspace says gbrain records every DM automatically and shows it only to the member who sent it, so his message should be stored privately to him. When I checked his record right away, there was nothing about this call yet; the recording may simply not have caught up. I didn't add it by hand because I couldn't confirm how to keep a manual entry private to him, and I didn't want to risk other people seeing it.

I took no other action: no calendar change and no posts anywhere else.
